presentationTrial.serial.boundary: At most two proposals, two generations, five renders and two anonymous reviews. Refine one configuration dimension; failed or unhelpful refinements retain the existing option. No automatic application or promotion.

presentationTrial.serial.enable: Try one serial refinement (two rounds total)
presentationTrial.serial.fallback: The refinement failed or proposed no configuration change. Its evidence and usage are retained; this comparison keeps the first round.
presentationTrial.serial.incumbentGuide: When present, the first candidate is the retained option; the second is the refinement. Ties or tradeoffs keep the retained option.
presentationTrial.serial.review: Final comparison uses round {{round}}; {{tokens}} tokens recorded across both rounds. Choose explicitly to create a new version.
presentationTrial.title: Compare representative pages
presentationTrial.validation.boundary: Freeze two new pages from independent tasks. The configuration stays fixed; held-out tasks are excluded from further search. Results require review and do not promote a default capability.
presentationTrial.validation.budget: Whole cohort: at most {{tokens}} tokens and {{seconds}} seconds; two probes, four renders and two anonymous reviews.
presentationTrial.validation.error: Validation could not proceed. Check that the experience has one adopted configuration change and that both source versions remain available.

presentationTrial.validation.state.prepa: Cohort frozen; no model calls yet.
presentationTrial.validation.title: Cross-task validation
presentationTrial.validation.verdict.ins: Insufficient evidence; missing or failed stages do not count as successes.
presentationTrial.validation.verdict.no-: Transfer improvement was not established on both pages. Keep the original capability.
presentationTrial.validation.verdict.reg: A held-out page regressed. Keep the original capability.
presentationTrial.validation.verdict.rev: Both independent pages improved: ready for human review, with no default promotion.
